name: Andrés Felipe Zapata
title: Software architect · Senior full-stack engineer (Java & Node.js)
tagline: 10+ years designing and building scalable systems.
summary: Full-stack software engineer with 10+ years of experience building platforms that serve 700,000+ users across Colombia and Latin America. Core stack: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus) and Node.js / TypeScript (NestJS) on the backend; Angular, React and Vue on the frontend; Next.js for full-stack applications; deployed on AWS and Kubernetes. I design microservice, integration and Kafka event-streaming architectures, and I lead engineering teams in payments, transportation, logistics and banking.
availability: Working remotely from Colombia (UTC−5). Open to architecture, integration and AI-native projects.

achievements.title: Electronic toll collection interoperability
achievements.body: Member of the team that built IP/REV (Electronic Vehicle Toll Collection Interoperability) for Colombia's Ministry of Transport, on an event-driven, highly concurrent, high-throughput transaction architecture.

achievements.title: RNDC integration
achievements.body: Integrated shippers and carriers such as Grupo Nutresa and Rápido Ochoa with the RNDC (National Cargo Dispatch Registry): consignment notes, electronic cargo manifests and proof-of-delivery records.

achievements.title: Latency in mission-critical microservices
achievements.body: From 5 s to 100 ms at 10,000 req/s in mission-critical microservices at Banco de la República (Colombia's central bank) using WebFlux, Redis and MongoDB.

achievements.title: Time-to-market
achievements.body: With a Developer Experience platform (Backstage, AWS Service Catalog, service archetypes) presented to the C-suite.

capabilities.name: Architecture
capabilities.body: Cloud-native designs on AWS, Azure and GCP. DDD, event-driven, observable from day one, load- and chaos-tested before shipping. Ten years across fintech, banking, logistics and transportation, with decisions written down as ADRs.

capabilities.name: Integration
capabilities.body: My trade is making systems talk to each other: Enterprise Integration Patterns with Apache Camel on Quarkus, and Kafka with Connect, Debezium and Streams. Payment gateways, partner and government APIs, message routing and transformation.

capabilities.name: AI-native developer
capabilities.body: AI is in every step of how I work: spec, design, code, review, release. Lately I build the AI side too: agent harnesses, MCP servers, skills, agents, and the governance that lets a company trust them. Claude Code, the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, LangChain, MCP and Hugging Face on the desk.

capabilities.name: Control bus
capabilities.body: More than 200 people led over the last five years. I coach developers into senior and architect roles and run corporate AI trainings, so a whole team can work this way, not just me. Code review culture, coding dojos, pre-sales and solution design.
